ownerDecision.request: add these new tanks using our rigoorous tank generation workflow; the christian 2 is based off the leopard, take innnspo from japanese type 90. but dress it in a ton of netting and ghillie; then: the new leo annd leo changes should rightfully be based on the new model and use totally new tank generation. the type 90 is a separate tank
ownerDecision.scope: A new Christian II: a fresh first-party build at the supplied concept model's measured proportions (a Leopard 2-pattern hull and seven-wheel running gear) carrying its own Type 90-inspired turret, Danish markings and paint and a heavy field net. The Type 90 X stays a separate tank (type90X.ts byte-identical). Nation ruled by the coordinator the same day: a fictional Danish Army concept drawn as a Nordic special in the Sweden tree. The supplied concept model is read for proportions only (not traced); nothing of it ships.

concept.operator: Danish Army (fictional concept; no real-world service history is claimed)
concept.rationale: A three-crew tank on a Leopard 2-pattern hull and running gear with a long slab-sided turret in the Type 90 manner (bolt-on frontal modules, box mantlet, the gunner's sight box and the commander's panoramic head on the roof) and a bustle autoloader feeding a 120 mm L/44, with a permanent heavy field net worked with beech garnish for a woodland theatre; it fires a DM53-class APFSDS.

christian2.silhouette: A Leopard 2-pattern hull (7.25 m between its plates, 7.855 m from the fenders' tips to the stern rack) on seven road wheels a side with four return rollers, heavy bolted skirt blocks forward and thin panels aft, carrying a long slab-sided turret in the Type 90 manner: two bolt-on frontal modules with chamfered outer corners framing a box mantlet, the gunner's armoured sight box on the right of the roof and the commander's panoramic head and vision-block cupola with a working 12.7 mm on the left, a stepped narrower bustle autoloader with blow-off panels, bins and a rear basket; a 120 mm L/44 with a thermal sleeve and evacuator; a permanent heavy field net with beech garnish over the turret, the decks and the skirts and three wraps on the tube. Roof 2.47 m, whips to 3.87 m.
